heroSub: 7 hotels handpicked for recovery stays near Yanhee International Hospital — from the only property you can walk to (2 min, 100 m) to adults-only riverside hotels with saline pools and lush gardens. Every entry is grounded in real guest reviews, with honest pros and cons, room prices, and direct booking links from three platforms.
introH2: Which type of hotel near Yanhee suits your recovery needs?
introHtml: Yanhee International Hospital on Charan Sanitwong Road in the Bang Phlat district is one of Asia's most renowned centres for cosmetic surgery and gender-affirming procedures, drawing patients from around the world who need to stay in Bangkok for days or weeks post-surgery. · Hotels near Yanhee fall into several distinct categories depending on what matters most to you — some patients need to walk to the hospital without waiting for a car, some need an in-room microwave and fridge to reheat food during recovery, some arrive with family and want a pool or fitness centre, and some simply want the most peaceful, noise-free environment they can find on the river. · This guide covers 7 hotels we have reviewed in depth that sit closest to Yanhee International Hospital. Every entry draws on real guest reviews, calls out genuine pros and concerns, and includes direct price comparisons across three booking platforms.
mrtHtml: Yanhee International Hospital is located on Charan Sanitwong Road in Bang Phlat, on Bangkok's Thonburi (west) bank. · The nearest MRT station is Bang Or (Blue Line), roughly 900 metres from the hospital — about a 10–12 minute walk or a quick motorbike-taxi ride from the station entrance. Bang Phlat MRT is also within the district. · From Suvarnabhumi Airport, a taxi or Grab takes approximately 45–60 minutes; expect to pay 350–450 THB including expressway tolls. From Don Mueang Airport, allow 30–45 minutes and budget around 250–350 THB. · Several hotels in this guide offer free parking, which is very convenient if family members are driving the patient. · None of the properties here operate a dedicated hospital shuttle, but Grab rides and motorbike-taxis are available around the clock from the entrance of every hotel on this list.

entries.addr: 67 Soi Charan Sanitwong 92, Bang Phlat, Bangkok
entries.storyHtml: If your priority is walking to Yanhee without waiting for a car — for daily dressing changes, follow-up visits, or early-morning appointments — H-Banaat Hotel is the clear frontrunner. Opened in 2025 on Soi Charan Sanitwong 92, it sits just 100 metres from the hospital entrance: a two-minute stroll. Cleanliness scores 9.8 out of 10 on Trip.com, and multiple reviewers note that staff are responsive and genuinely friendly. · The honest caveats: only 12 rooms, no pool, no breakfast, no parking, front desk closes at 22:00, and payments are cash only. If you are driving or need a pool, look at the other options below — but if the single requirement is walkable access to Yanhee, nothing on this list beats it.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: With only 12 rooms, this hotel fills fast — especially when Yanhee's appointment calendar is packed. Book at least 2–4 weeks ahead. Bring Thai baht cash; no cards accepted. If you arrive after 22:00, notify the hotel in advance.

entries.storyHtml: If your goal is the most restorative, peaceful recovery environment near Yanhee, WE Hotel Riverfront earns that title. This adults-only 4-star property (38 rooms) is tucked into a quiet soi along the Chao Phraya riverbank, 1.1 km from Yanhee — a 7-minute drive or short Grab ride. · Guest scores on Trip.com: overall 9.1 from 175 reviews, cleanliness 9.6, service 9.4 — the highest across all 4-star options in this roundup. The outdoor saline pool, lush garden, and on-site restaurant You & I (breakfast praised consistently) mean there is no reason to leave the property on a recovery day. · Honest notes: the hotel is tucked deep in a soi, so GPS can sometimes route drivers incorrectly — always send the correct map pin in advance. Mosquitoes appear in the garden at dusk; pack repellent. No in-room kitchen if self-catering is a priority.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Upgrade to a Riverview room if you are staying more than two nights — the river view genuinely makes recovery days feel better. Always send the hotel's Google Maps pin to your driver; the soi is narrow and some GPS systems route incorrectly.

entries.storyHtml: For patients who want a pool and fitness centre within a short drive of Yanhee without paying 4-star rates, P-Park Hotel Bangkok fills a gap that few hotels in this area can. The 3-star, 30-room property on Charan Sanitwong Road sits 700 metres from Yanhee — a 5-minute ride. · Score 9.1 from 137 reviews, service 9.4, cleanliness 9.3. Reviewers frequently describe rooms as larger than expected at the price. Staff are praised for English-language communication, which matters a great deal for international patients. Breakfast buffet, on-site Thai-American restaurant, and free parking round out a solid package for recovery stays. · Honest caveat: some rooms show cosmetic wear such as peeling wallpaper — check your room at check-in and report any issues promptly; reviewers say staff resolve problems quickly.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you are accompanied by a caregiver, the Deluxe Triple (~30 sq m) offers enough space to give both people room to breathe. Inspect your room at check-in and flag any wear directly — staff reportedly fix issues fast.

entries.storyHtml: For Yanhee patients on a tighter budget who still need a room that genuinely works for recovery, BeWish Residence Bangphlat is the best-value option on this list. This 20-room, 3-star serviced residence on Soi Charan Sanitwong 84 sits 600 metres from Yanhee — a 4-minute drive. Score 9.0 from 84 reviews, starting at approximately 700 THB per night. · The defining feature for post-surgery stays is practical: every room comes with a microwave, refrigerator, electric kettle, and balcony. You can reheat meals in the room, keep medications cold, and make drinks without leaving your bed — exactly what you need on days when moving is still uncomfortable. 24-hour security with key-fob entry and free parking are frequently praised by reviewers. · Honest notes: no breakfast, no pool, and 600 m to the hospital is too far to walk post-surgery — you will need a Grab for each visit.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: If you are checking in straight from the operating table, request a lower floor in advance (there is a lift, but minimising movement helps in the first day or two). Stock up on food, snacks, and supplies before your surgery date — there is a convenience store nearby.

entries.storyHtml: For patients planning a multi-week recovery who want a "living at home" setup with a full kitchen and washing machine, The Tree Rio Bang-Aor is the most interesting option in the group. This 40-storey high-rise sits on Charan Sanitwong Road, 400 metres from Yanhee (3-min drive) and roughly 100 metres from MRT Bang Or — the best transit connectivity of any hotel here. Facilities exceed what you would expect at the 3-star price: floor-40 infinity pool with Chao Phraya views, two-level fitness centre, sauna, and steam room. · Important: this is a private condo complex where each unit is owned and managed individually. Quality varies noticeably between units — you must read reviews specific to the listing you are booking and confirm check-in procedures before arrival. This caveat matters most if you are arriving directly from the hospital and need a reliable, smooth welcome.
entries.tipHtml: 💡 Tip: Contact your unit host at least one day before arrival to arrange check-in time — there is no 24-hour front desk. Read the unit's specific reviews, not just the building's name, before booking.

faqTitle: FAQ — Common Questions from Yanhee Patients About Nearby Hotels

faq.q: Which hotel is closest to Yanhee International Hospital — can I actually walk there?
faq.a: H-Banaat Hotel on Soi Charan Sanitwong 92 is the closest — just 100 metres from the hospital entrance, a 2-minute walk. It is the only property on this list where you can walk to the hospital without needing transport. Score 9.7 from 37 reviews; rooms opened 2025. Key limitations: only 12 rooms, no pool, no breakfast, no parking, cash only, and the front desk closes at 22:00.

faq.q: Which hotel is best for a long recovery stay of several weeks near Yanhee?
faq.a: It depends on your priorities. For a full kitchen and washing machine (ideal for living-in-place recovery), The Tree Rio Bang-Aor offers studio and 1–2 bedroom units from ~1,000 THB/night, with MRT Bang Or roughly 100 m away. For the most comfortable atmosphere with a saline pool and garden, WE Hotel Riverfront at ~1,500 THB/night is the top pick. If budget is tight but you still need in-room appliances, BeWish Residence at ~700 THB/night has a microwave, fridge, and kettle in every room.

faq.q: How do I get from Bangkok's airports to Yanhee International Hospital?
faq.a: The most straightforward option is a taxi or Grab directly to your hotel or the hospital. From Suvarnabhumi Airport, allow 45–60 minutes and budget approximately 350–450 THB including expressway tolls. From Don Mueang Airport, allow 30–45 minutes and budget around 250–350 THB. If you prefer public transport, take the MRT Blue Line to Bang Or station (about 900 m from Yanhee), then a short motorbike-taxi ride from the station exit.

faq.q: Which hotels near Yanhee have swimming pools, and what type?
faq.a: Several options are available. P-Park Hotel has an outdoor pool at ~850 THB/night, 700 m from Yanhee. WE Hotel Riverfront has an outdoor saline pool by the Chao Phraya River at ~1,500 THB/night, 1.1 km away. Beyond Suite Hotel has an indoor pool (no sun exposure, good for all weather) at ~1,500 THB/night, 700 m away. The Tree Rio Bang-Aor has a floor-40 infinity pool with river views at ~1,000 THB/night, 400 m away.

faq.q: Which hotels near Yanhee are best for international patients who do not speak Thai?
faq.a: P-Park Hotel Bangkok has the strongest English-speaking staff and is the most recommended for international patients based on reviewer feedback. H-Banaat Hotel staff are responsive even with some language limitations. WE Hotel Riverfront receives positive mentions for attentive service. For any property on this list, Google Translate and LINE messaging work well as communication back-ups — most staff can manage written exchanges even without spoken English.

faq.q: When does accommodation near Yanhee fill up, and how far in advance should I book?
faq.a: Yanhee's busiest appointment periods are typically November through February and the start of the calendar year. During these windows, the small cluster of hotels closest to the hospital fills quickly. Book at least 2–4 weeks in advance for H-Banaat (12 rooms) and P-Park (30 rooms), which are the most limited in capacity. For any property, booking a Free Cancellation rate first while your surgery date is confirmed is a sensible approach. Always compare prices across Agoda, Booking.com, and Trip.com before committing.
